evidence: Carries the Private Broadcast label and modifies private broadcast tracking in src/private_broadcast.cpp and net_processing.
rationale: Improves operator visibility into private broadcast transaction status by retaining finished transaction details in memory instead of dropping them immediately upon echo. The author notes that 'for finished transactions, this allows the inspection of when and to whom the transaction was sent as well as when/if it was echoed from the network,' which is a useful diagnostic improvement but not critical for relay correctness or network security.
